```{python}
from pathlib import Path


def find_project_root(start):
    path = Path(start).resolve()
    for candidate in (path, *path.parents):
        if (candidate / ".unaltraweb" / "computations.yml").is_file():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")


def points_attribute(points, offset_x, offset_y):
    return " ".join(f"{x + offset_x},{y + offset_y}" for x, y in points)


width, height = 1500, 720
input_points = [
    (70, 120), (150, 70), (190, 140), (230, 70), (310, 120),
    (270, 210), (300, 290), (190, 245), (80, 290), (110, 210),
]
convex_hull = [(70, 120), (150, 70), (230, 70), (310, 120), (300, 290), (80, 290)]
concave_hull = input_points
offsets = [(70, 120), (565, 120), (1060, 120)]

svg = [
    f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">',
    '  <title id="title">Comparació d’una envolupant circular, una envolupant convexa i una envolupant còncava</title>',
    '  <desc id="desc">Els mateixos deu punts queden continguts per un cercle, pel polígon convex mínim i per una possible envolupant còncava que segueix més de prop el patró però depèn del mètode i del paràmetre.</desc>',
    '  <defs>',
    '    <style>',
    "      text { font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; }",
    '      .panel { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #c5d0d5; stroke-width: 2; }',
    '      .heading { fill: #21313c; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '      .note { fill: #4e626b; font-size: 28px; }',
    '      .circle-hull { fill: #76aec5; fill-opacity: .18; stroke: #176486; stroke-width: 6; }',
    '      .convex-hull { fill: #78ad88; fill-opacity: .2; stroke: #2d7f5c; stroke-width: 6; }',
    '      .concave-hull { fill: #df9b71; fill-opacity: .22; stroke: #ad5531; stroke-width: 6; }',
    '      .point { fill: #803e72; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 4; }',
    '      .radius { stroke: #176486; stroke-width: 3; stroke-dasharray: 9 7; }',
    '    </style>',
    '  </defs>',
    '  <rect width="1500" height="720" fill="#f7f9fa"/>',
]

for x in (20, 515, 1010):
    svg.append(f'  <rect x="{x}" y="25" width="470" height="670" class="panel"/>')

svg.extend([
    '  <text x="255" y="80" text-anchor="middle" class="heading">Circular</text>',
    '  <circle cx="260" cy="300" r="160" class="circle-hull"/>',
    '  <line x1="260" y1="300" x2="420" y2="300" class="radius"/>',
    '  <text x="340" y="285" text-anchor="middle" class="note">radi</text>',
    '  <text x="255" y="590" text-anchor="middle" class="note">centre i radi resumeixen</text>',
    '  <text x="255" y="625" text-anchor="middle" class="note">la dispersió màxima</text>',
    '  <text x="750" y="80" text-anchor="middle" class="heading">Convexa</text>',
    f'  <polygon points="{points_attribute(convex_hull, 565, 120)}" class="convex-hull"/>',
    '  <text x="750" y="590" text-anchor="middle" class="note">polígon convex mínim;</text>',
    '  <text x="750" y="625" text-anchor="middle" class="note">omple totes les concavitats</text>',
    '  <text x="1245" y="80" text-anchor="middle" class="heading">Còncava</text>',
    f'  <polygon points="{points_attribute(concave_hull, 1060, 120)}" class="concave-hull"/>',
    '  <text x="1245" y="590" text-anchor="middle" class="note">segueix entrants, però canvia</text>',
    '  <text x="1245" y="625" text-anchor="middle" class="note">segons mètode i paràmetre</text>',
])

for offset_x, offset_y in offsets:
    for x, y in input_points:
        svg.append(f'  <circle cx="{x + offset_x}" cy="{y + offset_y}" r="11" class="point"/>')

svg.append('</svg>')
project_root = find_project_root(Path.cwd())
output = project_root / "assets/img/generated/06-analisi-geoprocessament-vectorial/envelopes-and-hulls.svg"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text("\n".join(svg) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
```
